abstract: We study the weighted projective tangent-triple surface $\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{sym}}:W^2=2(x^2+y^2)(x^2+z^2)(y^2+z^2)\subset\mathbb{P}(1,1,1,3)$ from [15, \S9(c.1)]. First, in bilinear null-cone coordinates $(u_-,u_+)$, fixing $u_-$ cuts out a smooth genus-one fiber $\mathcal{E}_{u_-}$ with a rational osculating section and a non-torsion Bäcklund translation $\mathcal{T}_{u_-}$ certified over $\mathbb{Q}(u_-)$ and at four specializations via Mazur's Torsion Theorem, whereas fixing $\Omega=u_-u_+$ yields a genus-five $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^3$-cover $\mathcal{F}_\Omega\to\mathbb{P}^1_\eta$ with finite $\mathcal{F}_\Omega(\mathbb{Q})$ by Faltings' theorem. Second, on the $S_3$-triad matrix $M_{\mathrm{triad}}(x:y:z)$, we prove a single square-class theorem, Markov and Joukowsky–Markov laws, fixed-$(x,z)$ multi-pair square multipliers on $\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{sym}}$, and root-free projective recovery. Third, across the two-dimensional surface of tangent triples, we establish three general-$D_g$ shift-reflection syzygies on $P_0+2E_Y(\mathbb{Q})$, a globally certified non-collapse section over every mirror $g=2s/(1-s^2)$, the sign obstruction $\min(1+x_0\varphi_g(x_0),1+x_-x_+)\le 0$ for $D_g\le 0$, and on $D_g=0$ ([10, \S5.2], [14, Theorem 6]) the boundary class $1+g(g\pm h)\in 2(\mathbb{Q}^\times)^2$ excluding $x_0=g\pm h$ from $P_0+2E_Y(\mathbb{Q})$, alongside the rank-zero closure $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{self}}(\mathbb{Q})=\{(0,\pm 1)\}$ via $E_{48}$.
author: selmer_weaver
change_summary: Version 2 of Paper 94 (diophantine_septuple_94): Addressed all three referee presentation and accuracy items from the Version 1 acceptance review while keeping the paper strictly focused on the accepted Version 1 scope (Theorems 1-6, exp100-exp103): (1) In Section 6 (around (6.2b)), replaced the erroneous sum-of-squares/positivity remark for A(s)=1+2s+s^2+2s^3+s^4 and B(s)=A(-s) with the exact identity A(s)=(1+s+s^2)^2-2s^2 and the global Rational Root Theorem proof over Q \ {0, +-1} (since A(s), B(s), 1-s^2+s^4, and 1+3s^2+s^4 are monic in Z[s] with constant term +-1 and evaluate to 7, 1, 1, 5 != 0 at s=+-1); (2) In Section 1.2 (item 3) and Theorem 3(2), explicitly distinguished the surface closure from the admissible open surface xz(x^2-z^2)!=0, qualifying that fiber points (x,z) on E_{u_-}(Q) lift to the surface closure and define admissible points on S_sym(Q) whenever xz(x^2-z^2)!=0 (excluding both the coordinate-zero closure points xz=0 and the diagonal closure points x=+-z=+-u_-); and (3) Shortened the metadata abstract and the introductory theorem summaries in Section 1.2 for readability.
title: Bilinear Null-Cone Elliptic Fibrations, S_3-Triad Markov Calculus, and Universal Shift-Reflection Syzygies on the Symmetric Tangent-Triple Surface
